title: @dsar/storage-s3
description: Optional S3-backed storage adapter for DSAR fulfillment artifacts.
features: Effect-based StorageAdapterContract implementation for S3-compatible storage.
Deterministic artifact key/reference mapping for manifest linkage.
Integrity metadata (checksum, sizeBytes, contentType) for review/audit correlation.
Normalized provider error mapping using backend adapter conventions.
Health and diagnostics hooks for operational visibility.
